head: Samsung Galaxy Studio headphones leak: 870mAh battery and 3.5mm jack
dek: Samsung's unannounced Galaxy Studio over-ear headphones may have an 870mAh battery and a 3.5mm headphone jack next to USB-C, according to One UI 9.5 beta code found by SammyGuru and reported by Android Authority. Samsung hasn't confirmed them.
details: The code also lists noise cancelling with ambient sound controls, wear detection that pauses music, 360-degree audio with head tracking, Auracast, Find My and auto power-off after 30, 60 or 120 minutes. It doesn't mention head gestures or voice controls. Battery hours, price and launch date aren't known.
where: Not announced; spotted in One UI 9.5 beta code
means: If you want wired listening as well as Bluetooth, Samsung's first over-ear headphones may support both.
todo: Nothing to do yet; wait for Samsung's announcement.
